issue.title: What is the best way to store globally accessible "heavy" objects?

issue.body:
Hey,
I'm working on a JWT autentication package for starlette, and I'm having few diffuculties on implementing it well:

1. When I decode the token, I want to "inject" the token's payload into the Request object. Currently the SessionMiddleware adds it to the scope, so currently i'm doing something like this:
```
request._scope['session'] = my_payload_dict
```
I wanted to add non-dict data to the Request's scope, in a way the IDE won't have issues with (since request.session is a method that returns a dictionary)

2. When I get a request in the middleware, I would like to get also the function which the Request is going to - since I want to add decorator to every route method:
```
@app.route('/')
@anonymous_allowed
def hello_world(request: Request):
    ....
```

I'm working on that git:
https://github.com/amitripshtos/starlette-jwt

What is the best way to achieving these 2 things in starlette, in your perspective?
Thanks,
Amit.
